name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px solid ring at 5:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility on all devices and avoids motion that could trigger vestibular disorders. The trade-off is a slightly larger ring that takes up more space, but clarity for keyboard users outweighs minimal design impact.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring still risks crowding small buttons on mobile touch targets, making them harder to hit. A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast meets WCAG AAA and stays visible on high-DPI screens without bulk. Settle it with user testing: measure tap accuracy and perceived focus clarity on a 48×48px button at arm’s length.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid ring at 7:1 contrast with no animation. This keeps focus visible on high-DPI screens and small touch targets while meeting WCAG AAA. The trade-off is slightly lower visibility on low-contrast backgrounds, but the smaller ring prevents crowding on mobile buttons and respects reduced-motion preferences. User testing will confirm tap accuracy and clarity.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast risks disappearing on glare-prone or low-contrast backgrounds, especially outdoors or in poorly lit rooms. A 3px ring at 6:1 contrast balances visibility across devices without crowding touch targets. Settle it by testing tap accuracy and perceived focus clarity on a 48×48px button in varied lighting conditions.
